The government will introduce an additional fee on low value imports; its design and amount are not yet set.
The government intends to retain the relief for genuine non-commercial consignments of £39 or less sent between private individuals.
VAT on these parcels has been charged at the point of sale since the 2021 changes (January 2021).

hook: Shipping shoes in their boxes? You might be paying to fly air.

beats.say: DHL Express divides length times width times height, in centimetres, by 5,000. Many MyCNBox lines list 6,000 to 8,000.
Six shoe boxes in one parcel: about 10 and a half volumetric kilos at 5,000. At 8,000, six and a half.
That's why some people ask the agent to ship shoes without the box. Check your line's divisor before you pay.
